meta.title: Model Guide & Cost Router
meta.description: Owner-curated model guidance overlaid on live provider discovery: reasoning settings, token rates, restrictions, and read-only agent guidance under the least-expensive-capable-model routing rule.

engineUpdate.sectionDescription: Latest upstream release versions for registered inference engines, checked from official GitHub release sources. No engine is installed or activated automatically.
engineUpdate.distinctionNote: An available upstream release does not indicate the engine is installed, and an installed version does not indicate it has passed verification with any specific model or GPU combination.

engineVerification.sectionDescription: Owner-recorded test evidence for specific engine/model/GPU combinations. A verification is only recorded after an actual test; it is never inferred from the installed version or the available upstream release.
engineVerification.noVerified: No verified configurations recorded for this engine.
engineVerification.distinctionNote: A verified configuration means the owner ran a real test with this exact engine version, model, and GPU set. It does not mean the configuration is currently installed or that it will work after any software change.
